newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Valentine for HK's Patten - from China with love?.
newsitem.headline: Valentine for HK's Patten - from China with love?.

text.p: Hong Kong Governor Chris Patten received an anonymous Valentine's greeting on Friday and an aide mused on whether he might have a secret admirer among China's Communist leaders.
The love greeting appeared as an advertisement in the daily HongKong Standard and said:

"To Beloved Brit Governor Patten. If once in a lifetime a wish could come true, I would open the door for you to walk through, the heart aches in this case is many? But the day I lose you will be the hardest of any, I only wanted you. Love?"
"This is probably from some secret admirer in the hierarchy in Beijing," Patten's spokesman told Reuters. "But I take it that it's not from Lu Ping."
Little love has been lost between the Governor and Lu Ping, China's chief of policy on the territory's handover to Chinese rule this year.
The two have frequently traded verbal attacks on issues such as the future of democracy and human rights.
Patten has been Beijing's nemesis for introducing democratic reforms in Hong Kong in its twilight years as a British colony before it reverts to Chinese sovereignty on July 1 this year.
